contentText: François Picard is pleased to welcome Kethevane Gorjestani & Patrice Paoli, former diplomat / spokesperson for the French government in Arabic. He offers a candid assessment of shifting global dynamics, particularly in response to US foreign policy under a combative, unpredictable President Donald Trump. At a time when traditional alliances and multilateral institutions face mounting pressure, Ambassador Paoli argues that Europe must step up with a clear, unified voice to defend international law, multilateralism, and cooperative engagement.
